ingredients.name: dried parsley or herbs de Provence

steps.instruction: Cook 1 1/2 pounds of potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 20 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cook the potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 20 to thirty minutes, until they are tender.

steps.instruction: Add 2 tablespoons of butter and 1/2 cup of milk to the potatoes.
Add 1 teaspoon of dried parsley or herbs de Provence and a pinch of nutmeg.
Mash the potatoes with a masher or an electric mixer.
Brown 1 diced onion in 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 pound of ground beef and cook until golden brown.
Add 1 tablespoon of herbs de Provence and 1 teaspoon of Worcestershire sauce.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and cook for 2 more minutes.
Press the beef into the bottom of a 6 to 8-inch baking dish.
Cover the beef evenly with 1 small can of whole kernel corn.
Cover that with 1 small can of cream style corn.
Finish with a layer of the mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle paprika on top, to taste.
If you like, finish under the broiler for no more than 2 minutes.
